tools.name: Hk_list_cases
tools.description: Paginated Hong Kong court cases. Filter by case_prefix (e.g. hccl, facv), year, category, titleContains, partiesContains (English or Chinese party name substring). Returns { data, total, page, limit }.

tools.name: Hk_get_case
tools.description: A single Hong Kong court case by id (format: caseNo/year, e.g. 12345/2024). Returns { data } with parties and files (null if not found).

tools.name: Hk_get_document
tools.description: Plain-text judgment for a Hong Kong court file by file id (judgment DIS id). Returns { data: { id, text } }. text is null when no converted HTML exists.
